objective: Verify Oriane retrieval and analysis capabilities before drafting a hackathon scope usable across apps.

hypotheses.claim: Lexical exact and fuzzy queries are distinct from semantic visual search
hypotheses.test: Compare exact, fuzzy and visual text-asset retrieval on travel apps
hypotheses.gate: Record relevant and irrelevant results; never equate fuzzy with semantics

hypotheses.claim: AI Vision can retrieve visual formats and styles independently of keywords
hypotheses.test: Compare UGC, motion design and anime prompts; inspect returned actual images
hypotheses.gate: At least 4/6 inspected thumbnails match observable visual category for provisional acceptance

hypotheses.claim: Broader value propositions yield useful analogies without brand names
hypotheses.test: Travel discovery/saving query then a second domain (habit/fitness app)
hypotheses.gate: At least 3/6 useful examples under a declared relevance rubric, without claiming representativeness

hypotheses.claim: Visual similarity combines with metadata and nested text filters
hypotheses.test: Combine visual asset, video format, platform, language/date/interaction bounds
hypotheses.gate: Every returned record satisfies non-null explicit constraints; record zero results

hypotheses.claim: First-seconds hook extraction has sufficient source evidence
hypotheses.test: Inspect full projection for selected records and segment/frame timing
hypotheses.gate: Separate exact timestamped text, overlapping coarse chunks, and missing evidence

hypotheses.claim: Interaction metrics can support fairer comparisons
hypotheses.test: Check counts/rates and retrieve same-profile cohort
hypotheses.gate: Verify rate units and denominators; do not claim sales, retention, organic uplift or audience country

relevanceRubric.direct: Same or closely competing app/use case
relevanceRubric.adjacent: Same domain and transferable user problem or demonstration
relevanceRubric.mechanism: Different app/domain but reusable creative mechanism
relevanceRubric.irrelevant: No defensible transfer to the brief

taxonomy.rule: Multi-label; UGC does not imply AI or human provenance; search prompts are not ground-truth labels.

steps: Throughput checkpoint stays one line: n/a, read-only investigation.
Snapshot documentation and declare tests before retrieval.
Run bounded lexical, semantic, visual and filtered queries; store exact requests and responses.
Inspect source frames and timing; label evidence and missing values.
Produce findings with go/no-go and conditional hackathon scope.
Apply the unslop skill to the reply.
